project.name: SEP490_25 - Document Management System with OCR
project.environment: Windows 10/11, Node.js 18+, PostgreSQL 16, Google Chrome, React/Vite, Express/Prisma

members: Coordinates test planning, develops features, prepares test evidence and reviews results.
Implements features, designs and executes unit and integration tests.
Implements features, prepares test data and executes integration and UAT scenarios.
Implements features, executes test cases and supports defect verification.

integration.objective: Authenticate a valid user and retrieve the current profile.
integration.steps: POST login; use token to GET profile.
integration.expected: JWT is issued and the matching profile is returned.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

integration.objective: Prevent unauthenticated access to protected APIs.
integration.steps: GET a protected endpoint without a token.
integration.expected: Returns an authorization error and no protected data.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

integration.objective: Complete the request-reset-change-password flow.
integration.preconditions: Active user and reset-token store are available.
integration.steps: Request reset; submit a valid one-time token and new password.
integration.input: Valid email; valid token; compliant password
integration.expected: Reset token is accepted once and the user can authenticate with the new password.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

integration.objective: Create a user with assigned system roles.
integration.steps: Create user; assign roles; retrieve detail.
integration.expected: User is stored with the selected role.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

integration.objective: Create a department hierarchy.
integration.steps: Create parent then child department.
integration.expected: Child is linked to the selected parent.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

integration.objective: Add and remove a user from a department.
integration.steps: Add member; retrieve members; remove member.
integration.input: Existing user ID and department ID
integration.expected: Membership is created then removed consistently.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

integration.objective: Maintain a role through the administrative API.
integration.steps: Create, update, list and delete a non-system role.
integration.expected: Each operation returns the expected role data.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

integration.objective: Create and maintain a document category with normalized name and code.
integration.steps: Create category; update it; list active categories.
integration.expected: Category is retrievable with its updated values.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

integration.objective: Create and maintain a document type.
integration.steps: Create type; update it; retrieve by ID.
integration.expected: Type is stored and returned with normalized code.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

integration.objective: Create a department document book and register a sequence safely.
integration.preconditions: Document clerk, department and document exist.
integration.steps: Create book; register document; inspect book entry.
integration.expected: A unique sequential number and snapshot entry are created.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

integration.objective: Create an incoming document and initial workflow record.
integration.steps: POST incoming document; retrieve details.
integration.input: Issuer, document number, received date, summary
integration.expected: Incoming and base document records are created in pending state.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

integration.objective: Upload a supported incoming file and retain OCR-assisted metadata.
integration.preconditions: DOCUMENT_CLERK is authenticated; supported file is available.
integration.steps: POST with-file; inspect returned document.
integration.input: PDF or supported image under 10 MB
integration.expected: File metadata is saved and OCR result/status is returned when processing succeeds.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

integration.objective: Register an incoming document in an incoming document book.
integration.preconditions: Unregistered incoming document and active book exist.
integration.steps: POST register; retrieve document and book entry.
integration.input: Book ID and valid arrival date
integration.expected: Unique arrival number and entry snapshot are stored.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

integration.objective: Forward an incoming document to a primary specialist processor.
integration.preconditions: Department head can access a pending document.
integration.steps: POST process with FORWARD.
integration.input: At least one XLC processor; instructions
integration.expected: Assignments, workflow history, status and notifications are created.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

integration.objective: Complete an assigned specialist task.
integration.steps: POST process-specialist with COMPLETE.
integration.expected: Processor task and document workflow are updated to completed.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

integration.objective: Return a document to the head and forward it again.
integration.steps: RETURN_TO_HEAD with reason; head FORWARDs again.
integration.expected: Return history is retained and the document can be reassigned.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

integration.objective: Allow comments while preserving XDB read-only access.
integration.preconditions: Head, specialist and XDB assignments exist.
integration.steps: Post comment; retrieve as XDB; attempt an action as XDB.
integration.expected: Comment is stored; XDB can view but cannot perform workflow actions.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

integration.objective: Create an outgoing document draft and optional incoming-document link.
integration.steps: POST outgoing document; retrieve details.
integration.input: Title, department, recipient and optional incoming ID
integration.expected: Draft is created with an internal document number.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

integration.objective: Upload a draft and execute OCR field extraction.
integration.preconditions: Outgoing draft is in DRAFT or RETURNED state.
integration.steps: Upload supported file; run OCR; review suggested fields.
integration.expected: File is saved, OCR status completes, and extracted fields are returned for review.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

integration.objective: Submit, return, resubmit and approve an outgoing document.
integration.preconditions: Draft has required metadata and file.
integration.steps: Update status through SUBMITTED, RETURNED, SUBMITTED and APPROVED.
integration.input: Valid workflow statuses and return reason
integration.expected: Only valid transitions occur and the approval trail is retained.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

integration.objective: Retrieve signature verification information for a supported uploaded file.
integration.preconditions: Outgoing document has a supported file.
integration.steps: GET verify-signature and signature details.
integration.expected: Signature summary or supported-file result is returned without changing the document.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

integration.objective: Register and issue an approved outgoing document.
integration.preconditions: Approved outgoing document and active book exist.
integration.steps: Move to WAITING_FOR_ISSUE; POST register; update to ISSUED.
integration.input: Dispatch metadata, book ID and issuance date
integration.expected: Official number, book entry and issued status are stored.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

integration.objective: Search, preview, archive, trash, restore and reopen document records.
integration.preconditions: Document clerk is authenticated; document exists.
integration.steps: Use list filters; preview; archive; delete; restore/reopen.
integration.expected: Lifecycle state and visibility follow each requested operation.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

integration.objective: Produce document statistics and export a filtered list.
integration.steps: GET dashboard statistics; export document list.
integration.expected: Statistics are returned and an Excel/PDF export is generated.
integration.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

uat.objective: A user signs in and sees only permitted navigation and actions.
uat.preconditions: Active users for all four roles exist.
uat.steps: Sign in as each role and review navigation.
uat.expected: Dashboard and actions reflect the authenticated role.
uat.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

uat.objective: Administrator creates and maintains a user account.
uat.steps: Create user; update profile data; lock/unlock; view detail.
uat.expected: User data and account status update correctly.
uat.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

uat.steps: Create departments; assign and remove member.
uat.expected: Organization tree and membership list reflect changes.
uat.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

uat.objective: Administrator maintains roles, categories, types and document books.
uat.steps: Create and view reference data and a book.
uat.input: Valid names/codes and active book settings
uat.expected: Reference data is available in document workflows.
uat.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

uat.objective: Document clerk creates an incoming document manually.
uat.steps: Open Add Incoming Document; complete required fields; save.
uat.input: Issuer, document number, received date and summary
uat.expected: New incoming document appears in the incoming list.
uat.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

uat.objective: Document clerk uploads a supported incoming file and reviews OCR suggestions.
uat.preconditions: Document clerk is signed in; sample file is available.
uat.steps: Upload file; wait for OCR; review metadata.
uat.expected: File preview and OCR-derived fields are available for verification.
uat.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

uat.objective: Document clerk registers an incoming document in a book.
uat.preconditions: Unregistered incoming document and active book exist.
uat.steps: Select Register; enter registration information; confirm.
uat.expected: Arrival number is assigned and shown in the document detail.
uat.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

uat.objective: Department head forwards an incoming document with a primary processor.
uat.preconditions: Department head has a pending incoming document.
uat.steps: Open Process; select XLC processor; submit forward action.
uat.expected: Document moves to in-progress and the specialist receives the assignment.
uat.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

uat.objective: Specialist completes an assigned incoming document.
uat.expected: Task completion is recorded and visible in workflow history.
uat.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

uat.objective: Users add comments and complete a return/reassignment loop.
uat.steps: Add comment; specialist returns with reason; head forwards again.
uat.expected: Discussion and workflow history are retained; reassignment succeeds.
uat.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

uat.objective: Specialist creates an outgoing document draft.
uat.steps: Open Create Outgoing Document; enter metadata; save.
uat.expected: Draft appears in outgoing document list.
uat.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

uat.objective: User uploads an outgoing draft file and reviews OCR suggestions.
uat.preconditions: Draft is open and supported file is available.
uat.steps: Upload file; run OCR; review extracted metadata.
uat.expected: OCR output is displayed and remains user-reviewable before submission.
uat.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

uat.objective: Department head returns and then approves a submitted outgoing document.
uat.steps: Return with reason; specialist resubmits; approve.
uat.expected: Status changes follow the defined workflow and history is visible.
uat.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

uat.objective: Document clerk registers and issues an approved outgoing document.
uat.preconditions: Approved outgoing document and active outgoing book exist.
uat.expected: Official number and ISSUED status are displayed.
uat.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

uat.objective: User previews/downloads a document and views signature information.
uat.preconditions: Document with uploaded supported file exists.
uat.steps: Open detail; preview/download; open signature panel.
uat.expected: File is accessible through authenticated requests and signature information is displayed when supported.
uat.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.

uat.objective: User filters documents, views statistics and exports a list.
uat.steps: Apply filters; open statistics; export result.
uat.expected: Filtered results, dashboard statistics and export file are produced.
uat.actual: Actual result matched the expected result.
